title: Data for universal finite filtered truncation triangles
statement: For an abelian category A [def-sp-abelian] with a chosen bounded-below derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], FilteredTruncationData(A) is the structure consisting of the localization $DF^+(A)$ of bounded-below cochain complexes with a uniformly finite filtration by subcomplexes at graded quasi-isomorphisms, with its cone-normalized triangulation, as set up in [lem-trf-filtered-derived-hom-calculus-base] [def-weil-triangulated-category], exact forgetful and graded functors to the ordinary bounded-below derived category, required to agree on representatives with the underlying complex and with the graded complexes $\operatorname{gr}^pK=F^pK/F^{p+1}K$, exact subcomplex and quotient truncation functors with their canonical inclusion, quotient, and connecting transformations, the distinguished truncation triangles and their support and uniqueness properties, the two natural Hom-set bijections expressing the right and left adjunctions, and the pure-grade placement equivalence with the ordinary derived category. The truncation functors are required to agree on representatives with F^p and M/F^pM, using filtered-complex subquotients [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and the pure-grade comparison is required to identify t_{\ge p}t_{<p+1} with gr^p by an isomorphism normalized on representatives by the canonical projection $F^pK\to\operatorname{gr}^pK$ and to allow acyclic rather than literally zero other graded pieces. The filtration operations use the decreasing filtration notion [def-sp-filtration].

F2 (H3, canonically): grade_truncation was an arbitrary iso; fixed by grade_normalization, which on representatives pins it to complexQuotientπ p (p+1). F3 (H12/H9): the new node cited def-trf-finite-filtered-localization, whose FiniteFilteredDerivedPlus is unused and is a different localization, and its import was unused; now cites lem-trf-filtered-derived-hom-calculus, which owns Derived false/Complex/forget/graded/high/low/TriangulatedLocalization; no cycle; import dropped. Everything else matches the node: uniform finite filtration, bounded below, cone-normalized triangulation, truncation comparisons and normalizations, distinguished triangle, ∃! iso fixing M, both Hom bijections, pure-grade equivalence with IsZero support; edge cases fine; HasDerivedCategory.{w} unrestricted; no hollow def; sorry only in the theorem; docstrings present; lean.statement verbatim. nt_compile --json: delivered pair clean; fixed module plus unchanged triangle module clean; control error reported.
